title: Standard flips of discrepancy one: extremal J-normalization and the Meijer aperture at nu = 1
description: This note completes the discrepancy-one range r = s + 1, s >= 1, in Shen and Shoemaker's extremal quantum-spectrum and Gamma-class argument for standard flips. An exact z-order count shows that their hypergeometric I-function is already J-normalized throughout this range, including every codimension-two blow-up. The note also applies the epsilon = 1/2 branch of their Barnes asymptotic theorem at nu = 1 and proves that the corrected Meijer sector still has the common aperture required for the nonzero-eigenvalue and tame asymptotic classes. The formal rank-one projective-bundle endpoint is separated explicitly; its point fibres contain no extremal line.
